name: Rule grant fully overridden by same-policy Deny -> blocked-by-deny edge
note: Allow ec2:TerminateInstances on a concrete instance, with an unconditional same-policy Deny of the same action on the same resource. rules.js still emits the DESTRUCTIVE-ACTION capability finding (it is not Deny-aware), but graph.js applies AWS explicit-Deny precedence: the can-destroy edge is blocked-by-deny, not confirmed-by-context. Overstating it as confirmed would be a truthfulness harm (threat-model T8).
